HEADLINE: The Board of Directors of SK International Export Limited (hereinafter referred to as 'SKIEL') ('the Company') at its meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, October 28, 2026, have duly approved ....
MORE:
The Board of Directors of SK International Export Limited (hereinafter referred to as 'SKIEL') ('the Company') at its meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, October 28, 2026, have duly approved the unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, together with the Limited Review Report of the auditors in terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which is enclosed herein as an annexure. 

The Board Meeting of the Company commenced on 16:10 HRS (IST) and concluded at 19:45 HRS (IST).

Kindly take the above on record.
